description.narrative: (Ethiopia): .FETEH is a two-year activity that will provide flexible and rapid response technical assistance to the Attorney General's Office (AGO), relevant sub-committees within the AGO, the Federal Supreme Court of Ethiopia (FSCE), appropriate committees in Parliament, and/or other related government ministries in the reform process. The activity will make grants to civil society organizations and media to ensure public input into the democratic reform process, improving citizen engagement and public consultation of proposed changes to Ethiopia's legal and judicial framework. Specifically, FETEH will:.a. Build the capacity of the AGO, its 14-person Council, its legal drafting sub-committees, FSCE and other rule of law actors to adopt and implement legal and judicial reform consistent with international human rights norms..b. Support the ability of civil society organizations and the media to engage the AGO and the legal drafting sub-committees on legal and judicial reforms..c. Support the appropriate committees in Parliament to ensure that they develop sufficient capacity to approve the adoption of legal reforms...d. Support the FSCE with improving Ethiopia's court management system... ..Establishing and solidifying the root of Ethiopia's ability to enforce the rule of law is a critical means through which Ethiopia can maintain transparency, openness, and stability. Without accountability, fair and just laws, transparency, and access to justice, conflict brews. The new Ethiopian Government is in a sensitive time of transition by which triggers such as conflict are highly de-stabilizing and harmful to promising, western-leaning reforms. ... .
